scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:registrar
scripts.test:unit: node --test lib/auth/logic.test.js lib/auth/profileSchema.test.js lib/auth/registration.test.js lib/auth/verificationCodes.test.js lib/auth/verification.test.js lib/auth/callerGuard.test.js lib/auth/callerGuardCoverage.test.js lib/auth/account-lifecycle.test.js lib/domain/validation.test.js lib/domain/ownership.test.js lib/bridge/registryClient.test.js lib/api/updateFunctions.test.js lib/domain/getDomainInfo.test.js lib/api/infoCallables.test.js lib/domain/dnsZones.test.js lib/api/dnsRecords.test.js lib/api/updateAutoRenew.test.js lib/api/getOrder.test.js lib/api/getMyProfile.test.js lib/api/updateMyProfile.test.js
scripts.test:integration: node --test lib/auth/verification.integration.test.js lib/auth/auth.integration.test.js lib/auth/lifecycle.integration.test.js lib/auth/session.integration.test.js lib/domain/renewDomain.test.js lib/api/renewOrder.test.js lib/api/createOrder.test.js lib/domain/domainRepository.integration.test.js
scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions
scripts.test:registrar: npm run build:test && cd lib-test/test && node --test --test-concurrency=1
scripts.test:docker: docker exec -e FIRESTORE_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:8080 registrar-firebase-emulators sh -lc 'cd /workspace/functions && npm run build:test && cd lib-test/test && node --test --test-concurrency=1'
